description: EXECUTE IMMEDIATE ... USING: rejected at session level (with the two live-measured wordings), binds inside scripting blocks, string-escape of binds, and the RETURN-expression rejection. Converted 1:1 from features/ExecuteImmediateUsingTest.java (now retired; exact-message asserts became distinctive messageContains).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE t (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR)
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'INSERT INTO t VALUES (?, ?)' USING (1, 'Alice')
CREATE TABLE u (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR)
DECLARE i INTEGER DEFAULT 7; nm STRING DEFAULT 'Bob'; BEGIN   EXECUTE IMMEDIATE 'INSERT INTO u VALUES (?, ?)' USING (i, nm);   RETURN 'ok'; END
SELECT name FROM u WHERE id = 7
CREATE TABLE p (id INTEGER, price INTEGER)
DECLARE minp INTEGER DEFAULT 100;         q STRING DEFAULT 'INSERT INTO p_out SELECT COUNT(*) FROM p WHERE price > ?'; BEGIN   EXECUTE IMMEDIATE :q USING (minp);   RETURN 'ok'; END
DECLARE q STRING DEFAULT 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM r'; BEGIN   RETURN (EXECUTE IMMEDIATE :q); END
